اجلعدا (form IVq)
# اِجْلَعَدَّا (ijlaʕaddā) /id͡ʒ.la.ʕad.daː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِجْلَعَدَّ (ijlaʕadda)
# اِجْلَعِدَّا (ijlaʕiddā) /id͡ʒ.la.ʕid.daː/: second-person dual imperative of اِجْلَعَدَّ (ijlaʕadda)
